Kristof’s May 2026 opinion piece came MULTIPLE YEARS after the story of israel’s systematic rape of Palestinians in israeli torture centers was broken by a plethora of human rights organizations, such as the UN Humans Rights Commission and B’TSelem @btselem and other media outlets, such as Middle East Monitor @middleeastmonitor and Electronic Intifada @electronicintifada - and not hidden in their opinions section like the NYT. 

Kristof’s piece also references the widely debunked Oct. 7 rape accusations against Hamas as fact multiple times… Accusations which were originally published by the NYT in their notorious 2023 “Screams Without Words” news article written by IOF terrorist Anat Scwartz, which the NYT still refuses to retract despite it being widely debunked. 

The New York Times cannot wash the blood off their hands. Kristof’s piece does not absolve the NYT of any of its lies against humanity.
